- scripts/mark-stable.sh:99–175 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `PREVIOUS_STABLE_LEASE` is set from `git rev-parse --verify` without the `^[0-9a-f]{40}$` shape check that the sibling `PREVIOUS_MAJOR_LEASE` block applies immediately below it.
  WHY: if `git rev-parse --verify` ever returned an empty or non-SHA value, the push would receive `--force-with-lease=refs/tags/stable:` or `...:garbage`; both fail closed, but the error surfaces as a confusing exit 8 instead of the explicit “could not read previous stable tag” message the major branch emits on the same failure class.
